messages.一件东西被留在这里，是因为它坏了，还是因为再没有人回来做下一步？我还不能从这道缝: Was this left here because it broke, or because no one ever came back for the next step? I can't tell from this seam.
messages.一份名单是在清点还活着的人，还是在要求已经离开的人继续应声？旧孔没有替我回答。: Is a list counting those still alive or demanding that those who have left keep answering? The old nail holes do not tell me.
messages.一列列钥位原本可以分开辨认。后来加上的铜轨横过末端，把视线带向同一处；若从总锁往: The rows of key positions could once be read separately. A later bronze rail crosses their ends, drawing the eye to one point. Look back from the master lock and it's easy to forget that each line once had its own direction.

I looked at the empty positions one by one, stopping where the rail joined them. A link can make many actions happen together. It can also reduce choices that should stay separate to a single turn. How alike those two uses look.
messages.一枚工牌不是完整户册，不能靠它补出所有名字，也不能推定持牌者同意交出名字。: One tag is no census. It cannot restore every name or show that its wearer agreed to give theirs up.
messages.一瞬绷紧的线，接着空中的第二针。我越来越擅长越过空隙，也该学会在落稳以后停一停。: The thread draws taut, then comes a second stitch in the air. I'm learning to cross the gaps. I should learn to pause once I've landed, too.
messages.一路拾得的松脂碎片，可用来兑换巡礼所需。: Fragments of resin gathered on the road. Trade them for supplies for the pilgrimage.
messages.一页原件只能证明这处条文的改动，不能据此替六城所有人表达愿望。: An original page proves a change to this passage. It does not express the wishes of everyone in the six cities.
messages.一颗较早刻下的心，与后来牵向小轮廓的细线，刀痕先后不同。: A heart was cut first. Fine lines reaching toward small figures were added later. The cuts belong to different hands or times.

The tripwire stake turns a tension latch from an old pump gate into a portable device. Repairing the bronze badge and the load-bearing knot allowed the rain smith to revive the craft of the Bellfounder's Seal.

messages.不向架刃连续出针；看到连斩要等左右两侧都收完。: Avoid repeated strikes into the guard. Let both sides of the cutting chain finish.
messages.不是。那副剪子切的是回声线，工匠的锤子要把线铆牢。你看接口，手法都不一样。: No. Those shears cut echo threads. A smith's hammer rivets them fast. Look at the joints. The hands worked quite differently.
messages.不要一直贴盾追击；先看清盾突，再从收招找空隙。: Give the shield room. Read the charge and strike during its recovery.
messages.不要因为本体移走就踩回预警区域；等影刃结束。: Keep off the marked space even when the body leaves. Wait for the blade to finish.
messages.不要按单一节奏追打；确认波速变化再跳。: Vary your pursuit. Read each wave's speed before jumping.
messages.不要沿根刺展开方向连退；等最后一段消退再进攻。: Avoid retreating along the spikes' path. Wait for the last to fade before attacking.
messages.两处实物证明条款范围被扩大，但没有给出改写者的完整行踪。: Both objects show that the covenant's scope was widened. Neither gives a full account of the hand that changed it.
messages.个人承诺的范围与主动拒绝开门的痕迹同时成立。镇潮的功用不能替后人签字，抵押的起因: A limited personal pledge and a deliberate refusal to open can both be true. Holding the tide cannot sign for later generations. The first pledge does not excuse whoever later locked the gate.
messages.个人自愿抵押，不等于后代已经作过相同选择。: A willing personal pledge is no record that the next generation made the same choice.
messages.为了躲低波而贴近时，有没有进入铃杖范围？远近转换前先看它此刻准备哪种动作。: Did closing in to evade a low wave put you within staff range? Read the next move before switching ranges.
messages.为了避开俯冲而后撤时，有没有看见封住后方的双针？先看新的落点，再决定往前还是往后: Did you notice the needles behind you as you retreated from the dive? Find a landing before deciding whether to move forward or back.
messages.为躲轮波起跳前，是否看清钥阵的返程？冠门封线改变落脚范围后，先重选地面，再计划追: Before jumping the wheel wave, did you see the keys coming back? The gate's seals change the landing zone. Pick new ground before pursuing.
messages.举旗引导为附近受伤同伴回一格；击中可打断，独处仍用旗枪连击与退刺: Channels through its banner to heal a nearby wounded ally by one point. Hits interrupt it. Alone, it chains flag-spear strikes and a retreating thrust.
messages.举旗能为附近伤员恢复，独处仍会连击。: Raising the banner can heal nearby allies. Alone it still attacks in combinations.
messages.书托沿窄轨进入双辊，纸屑和盐粉落在同一条槽里。原本用于压平受潮书页的刮刀，也被用: Book cradles run down narrow rails into twin rollers. Paper scraps and salt powder fall into the same groove. The scraper once used to flatten damp pages was also used to erase words from the covenant.

messages.书记带出的抄页与找到的原件需要互核。记下两种责任，不等于已经追完每一次改约的经手: The scribe's copy must be checked against the original that was found. Recording two kinds of responsibility does not identify every hand that altered the covenant.
messages.井喉保存了承诺的范围，冠肋保存了拒绝开门的痕迹。守潮之功与吞钥的决定都在，不能拿: The well throat preserves the limits of a promise. The crown rib preserves a refusal to open. Holding back the tide and swallowing the key both happened. The former does not automatically excuse the latter.
messages.井喉保存承诺的范围，肋骨保存拒绝开门的痕迹。两者都要解释；不能用守潮之功替吞钥作: The well throat preserves the scope of a promise, and the rib preserves a refusal to open. Both need explaining. Holding back the tide does not justify swallowing a key.

messages.井壁先刻下一颗心，后来才添上牵向后人的线。守母的个人抵押与后加的人群，应分开辨认: A heart was carved into the well wall first. The threads leading to later generations came afterwards. The Matriarch's personal pledge and the people later bound to it are separate matters.
messages.井壁原有承诺与书库原页放在一起，能分清自愿抵押和后加的世袭。期限被延长、承担者被: Together, the well carving and the archive page distinguish a voluntary pledge from an inherited burden added later. Extending the term and adding new debtors were two parts of the same dispossession.
messages.井壁后添的人形与原页更深的“后嗣”墨迹互相印证：个人承诺被扩展到后人，这一扩展不: The figures added to the well wall and the darker ink used for “descendants” on the original page corroborate each other. A personal promise was extended to later generations. They never made that promise themselves.
messages.井壁的先后刀痕与原页的深浅墨迹分属两处实物，都区分原约与后加条款；它们能互证改动: Cuts of different ages on the wall and inks of different darkness on the original page both distinguish the first covenant from a later clause. They corroborate the change, but do not identify its author.

messages.六份证词分别保存了抵押、登记、改约、留音、点名和锁门的痕迹。巡礼者能把它们带到一: Six testimonies preserve traces of a pledge, a registration, an alteration, a recorded voice, a roll call and a locked gate. A pilgrim can bring them together to show what happened.
messages.养根的旧弦与接向钟网的新箍挤在同一处。我能看见两层做法，便不把护住母株和永远征走: The old string that fed the roots and the new hoop that joined the bell network crowd the same spot. I can see both layers now. Protecting the mother plant and taking a voice forever are two different acts.
messages.再次按键才触发；落地后恢复次数。: Press jump a second time to trigger it. Landing restores the extra jump.
messages.军令已经辨认；可以回营地，听他怎样面对仍会响起的旧号。: He has identified the order. Return to the camp and hear how he faces the old call that still sounds.
messages.军册与活弦各自保留了原用途与后来接入钟令的层次。能确认的是征用的结构相似，不能因: Both the roll and the living string show their first uses beneath later links to the bell order. The forms of requisition are alike, but that does not make the songkeeper and the commander one person.

messages.军册没有记录每位亡者的回答；重新编入，不能解释成再次同意。: The roll gives no answer from each of the dead. Entering them again does not mean they consented again.
messages.军册的重编与活弦的新箍都把原有关系接入钟令。记得一个人、照看一棵树，与有权永远征: Renumbering the roll and fitting the living string with a new hoop both joined older bonds to bell orders. Remembering a person or tending a tree grants no perpetual right to requisition either.

messages.分开的开门、停钟与放水被接入总轨，曾救下人，也让小门失去各自开启的权力。守门者吞: Opening gates, stopping bells and releasing water once required separate decisions. Joining them to a main rail saved lives, but took away each smaller gate's power to open on its own. Why Gatewarden swallowed keys that still worked is a question in its own right.

messages.压页的边缘比台面中央更光。页角经过时会在这里被拢住，纸张离开以后，木台仍把那道转: The edge of the page press is shinier than the middle. Here a passing corner was gathered in. The paper is gone, but the wood still holds the turn it made. A book takes many small gestures like that before it truly closes.

The edge of the page press is shinier than the middle. Here a passing corner was gathered in. The paper is gone, but the wood still holds the turn it made. A book takes many small gestures like that before it truly closes.

Looking at the empty table, I thought of the words first and only later of the hands that held the corners. Titles and numbers are easy to copy into a journal. There is no equally short name for the gesture of holding a page.

messages.罐口还留着旧钟匠的绕线槽，铜铃投罐沿用了这套封口手法。绘图者把钟楼报时骨片磨成指: The jar mouth still bears an old bellfounder's winding groove. Bronze Bell Jars use the same seal. Cartographers ground the belfry's timekeeping bone into a pointer for the Bellbone Compass.
messages.肋骨内侧的磨痕保留了钥匙被收进门内的方向。: Wear inside the rib shows which way the key was drawn through the gate.
messages.背景边缘不能攀附；蹬离后观察下一块落脚处。: Scenery offers no grip. Look for your next foothold as you push off.
messages.能穿过阴影，也能越过旧门。我仍会先看一眼出口；走得更快，并不使每条路都值得立刻踏: I can pass through shadow and clear the old gates. I'll still look for the exit first. Moving faster doesn't mean every road is worth taking at once.
messages.脚下圈与低页: The ground seal and low pages
messages.至少%d处匹配，仅列前%d处。: At least %d matches. Showing the first %d.
messages.花心投种，落点生刺；近处吐针: Casts seeds that sprout thorns on landing and spits needles at close range.
messages.花种落地后才生刺，近处还会吐针。: Seeds sprout thorns after landing. The flower can also spit needles up close.
messages.花粉改变移动节奏后，是否还用原来的步幅估计落圈？先给慢下来的身体留出足够距离。: Were you judging the circles by your normal stride after the pollen slowed you? Give your slower movement enough room.
messages.若入口已购图并补绘，可在地图地点目录的入口线索类型中回看；不会自动揭开藏室或奖励: Once you own the map and have charted the entrance, look under Entrance Clues in the map directory. This does not reveal the hidden room or its reward.
messages.若只把书页上的字记下来，会不会也把让这些字得以留下的劳作漏掉？: If I record only the words on the page, will I miss the work that allowed those words to remain?
messages.若有一天能拆开这道连接，需要先记住的，也许不只是总锁如何开启，还有每一列原先负责: If this link can ever be taken apart, we may first have to remember not only how the master lock opens, but what each row once did.
messages.若目标正在后撤，先确认距离；收势期间留意背后。缝名的线势会改变范围，观察当前构筑: Check your reach against a retreating target and watch your back during recovery. Name-Stitching tension changes the reach, so judge the distance for your current build.
messages.荆针与横向根墙封住不同通路。: Needles and the root wall block different routes.
messages.获得永久能力、确认交谈或近看遗迹后，可以在这里回看旅途自述。: Acquire an ability, finish a conversation or inspect a ruin to add a pilgrim's reflection here.
messages.营床木条被重新钉回轮中，分开的钥匙又接向总锁。两处都还看得到先前的分工；我没有把: The bunk slat was nailed back onto the wheel. Separate keys were led back to the master lock. Both still show the old division of work. I won't record their joining as the only way.
messages.营床的木条原本能够拆下，军册却让亡者换个编号归队。我把那一格留空，没有替写在碑上: The bunk slat could once be removed. The roll gave the dead a different number and drew them back into the ranks. I left that space empty. I did not answer for the person whose name is on the stone.
messages.落脚后再连续突进；突进不是传送。: Find your footing before dashing again. A dash does not teleport you.
messages.藤口咬击，身前三段根刺依次冒出: Bites with its vine maw and sends three successive root spikes up in front of it.
messages.藤种让移动变慢之后，是否继续走原来的最长路线？根刺标记与交错根墙之间，先给自己留: Did you still take the longest route after the vine seeds slowed you? Keep a short way out between the spike marks and crossed walls.
messages.虚晃短刺后退，双段追刺: Feints a short thrust, steps back and follows with a two-part pursuit.
messages.蜡枪冲刺留下地面烛蜡，需跃过尾迹: Charges with a wax lance and leaves a trail of wax to jump over.
messages.蜷壳后会向前扑，别把蓄力当作停手。: A curled shell means a forward pounce is coming.
messages.衣缝里的灯影散开之后，钟声仍能回应。我想带回来的名字，不该只在明亮处才有位置。: When the lantern light leaves my seams, the bell can still answer. The names I want to bring back deserve a place in the dark as well as in the light.
messages.补灯的报酬已经谈清；可以再看看，这一次照看的边界如何留下。: Payment for the lamp repair has been settled. Visit again to see where they drew the limits of this undertaking.
messages.被夹击时先看两侧是否已有攻击起手。缝名的线势提供有限命中回能，不能依赖它填满一次: When surrounded, check both sides for attacks already winding up. Name-Stitching tension returns a little thread on hit. Don't count on it to fund an emergency heal.
messages.被根网限制时是否仍按原来的后退节奏移动？先看长扑的方向，给受限的脚步选一条更短的: Did you try retreating at your usual pace while snared? Read the lunge and choose a shorter escape for your slowed steps.
messages.西门已有一次获救的落脚；可以听他谈谈，钟声回来后怎样守住自己的选择。: The west gate has given him a foothold since his rescue. Hear how he protects his choice now that the bells ring again.
messages.要。你打倒的是拦路的身体，添在刻痕上的细线还在那里。: Yes. You defeated the body barring the way. The fine lines added to the carving are still there.
messages.见证不等于获得替所有人签字的权力；归还名字、声音与选择，也不能凭空免去守潮的责任: Witnessing does not give you leave to sign for everyone. Giving names, voices and choices back cannot by itself lift the duty of holding back the tide.
messages.解缚后由他自己确认去路；重逢地点跟随已经保存的人物迁移。: Once freed, he will choose his own route. The meeting place follows the move recorded in your save.
messages.让开冲锋线，再确认灰钉间的返回通路。: Clear its charge lane, then find a way back between the spikes.
messages.让开钟轮后继续看低波，别立即落回原位。: After evading the wheel, look for the waves before landing where you started.
messages.让能辨认旧字的人核对证物；持有原件本身还不等于这次核对已经完成。: Let someone who knows the old script check what you found. Holding the original does not itself complete that check.
messages.记住花种落点；靠近前先确认地面没有迟发刺。: Remember where the seeds fell. Check for delayed thorns before closing in.
messages.记录内容已变化；旧标记保留，可保存当前位置替换。: This entry has changed. Its old bookmark is kept until you save a new position.
messages.证物给了复核登记的理由；某个名字的归属仍要与当事人的证言逐项核对。: The evidence warrants checking the register. Each name still needs a witness who can identify its owner.
messages.证词：已取得 %d / %d；集齐后，第三扇结局门可以打开: Testimony collected: %d / %d. Collect them all to open the third ending gate.
messages.请他辨认召回线，等他自己决定怎样处置；交谈与迁移会一起保存。: Ask him to identify the recall thread, then wait for him to decide what to do with it. The conversation and his move will be saved together.
messages.请先筛选1至256条已知记录。: Filter the list to between 1 and 256 known entries first.
messages.请先选择一条已知旅记。: Choose a known journal entry first.
messages.请在钟龛旁打开构筑页。: Open the build page beside a bell shrine.
messages.请重新核对后再确认。: Review the updated results before confirming.
messages.贴近盾面时，是在等收招还是继续出针？退开盾突后，是否仍处在长矛够得到的位置？: At its shield, were you waiting for recovery or still swinging? After evading the rush, were you outside the spear's reach?
messages.费用、恢复量和打断损失会随契印与装备改变，请看战斗 HUD 的当前提示。: Your seals and equipment affect the cost, healing amount and loss on interruption. Check the combat HUD for current values.
messages.起初等活着的。后来我只求能再听一声，没分清从哪里传来。: At first I waited for the living. Later I only wanted to hear a voice again. I stopped asking where it came from.
messages.越过、牵引、攀住；我有了三种继续前进的办法。旧路上的小小停顿，仍值得我带着新本领: Leap across, draw myself up, hold fast. I have three ways forward now. The little places where I once had to stop are worth revisiting with these new skills.
messages.跃转剪开始时，是否仍站在刚刚躲过夹剪的一侧？先辨认线的交叉方向，再安排换边后的停: When the spinning cut began, were you still where you dodged the closing shears? Read the cross first, then choose your stopping place.
messages.跪姿瞄准后是窄幅三连射。: The kneeling aim precedes three shots in a narrow spread.
messages.跪姿瞄准后窄幅三连射，瞄准阶段可脱离射线: Kneels to aim, then fires a narrow three-shot burst. You can leave the line while it aims.
messages.跪姿瞄准时是否及时离开射线？第一发过去之后，是否等到后两发结束才重新穿行？: Did you leave the line as it knelt? Once the first shot passed, did you wait for the remaining two before crossing?
messages.跳刺后落地水波，腾空时可绕到身后: Leaps with a thrust and sends a wave out on landing. You can slip behind it in midair.
messages.跳刺落地还会放出水波。: Its landing releases a water wave after the thrust.
messages.身前三段根刺依次冒出。: Three root spikes rise in sequence ahead of it.
messages.躲过冲撞是否就马上回身？先确认近身震地结束，再把较长的收招留给自己的攻击。: Did you turn back as soon as the charge missed? Let the ground slam end before spending the recovery window on your own attack.
messages.躲过本体后继续离开回声落点，再回身出针。: Dodge its body, then clear the echo's landing before turning to strike.
messages.躲过枪尖后是否落在烛蜡上？反击路线有没有经过冲刺留下的地面，而不是只经过它现在的: After dodging the point, did you land on wax? Does your counterattack path cross the ground the charge just covered?
messages.躲过长扑后有没有马上踩回原地？回声落点到来前，身体是否仍有可继续移动的空间？: Did you step straight back after dodging the pounce? Keep enough room to move again before the echo lands.
messages.轮盾冲锋，回旋刃飞出后返身: Charges behind a wheel shield. Its spinning blade comes back after the throw.
messages.输入要在本条正文中查找的字面文字。: Enter the exact text you want to find in this entry.
messages.辨清剪口与线的方向，换边后再找下一处站位。: Read the blades and the threads, then choose where to stop on the other side.

messages.还没有旧旅途。另起新旅途时，旧进度会另存保留。: No past journeys yet. Starting a new journey will archive your old progress.
messages.这一分类暂无物品: No items in this category yet
messages.这一分类暂无记录: No records in this category yet
messages.这一单已经交清；可以再谈谈，下一班照灯的人如何留下自己的同意。: This order is settled. Ask how the next lamp tender can leave a record of their own consent.
messages.这些是已知的可选委托；回访不会改变已经选定的结局。: These are known, optional commissions. Revisiting them leaves your chosen ending intact.
messages.这些材料没有替六城列出一套无需代价的办法；今后的维护仍要由活着的人商量。: These objects offer no cost-free plan for the six cities. The living must still negotiate their future work.
messages.这些辨认来自已经听完并保存的追问；可以回看当时的原话，不替说话者补写答案。: These identifications come from follow-up conversations you finished and recorded. The original words are preserved without supplying answers the speaker never gave.
messages.这份契约还有未完成的记录。: This contract still has outstanding observations.
messages.这条记录尚无已保存的阅读标记。: This entry has no saved bookmark.
messages.这条记录没有已保存标记。: There is no saved bookmark for this entry.
messages.这次是在它蜷壳时后退，还是等扑身已经到面前才移动？落稳之后是否仍留着退路？: Did you retreat when it curled up, or only once the pounce was upon you? Where can you retreat after it lands?
messages.这次补灯的材料与报酬已经谈清，之后仍可回商人处重逢。: You have agreed on materials and payment for the lamps. You can still revisit the merchant afterwards.
messages.这里只整理亲手取得的证词；新发现可能补充理解，阅读本身不会取得证物或推进委托。: These notes draw only on testimony you collected. Later discoveries may add to them. Reading an entry neither grants evidence nor advances a commission.
messages.这里让人看见守潮与锁住人声之间的缝隙；它没有替巡礼者取得证词，也没有替任何人作出: Here you can glimpse the distance between holding back the tide and locking away people's voices. Seeing it gives the pilgrim neither testimony nor the power to make anyone's final choice.
messages.远处看低波，近处看铃杖；不要在它身前原地疗伤。: Watch the waves at a distance and the staff up close. Avoid healing directly in front of it.
messages.远程出针仍要留出自己的收势空间。校录可借命中留下盐记；不要把一次远程命中当成连续: Leave room to recover even at range. A Scribe can leave a salt mark on hit, but one ranged hit will not keep an enemy pinned down.
messages.追着投种的花心靠近时，是否进入近处吐针范围？远处落点尚未生刺时，先安排好下一处地: Did following the seed-throwing flower put you in needle range? Pick your next patch of ground before the distant seeds sprout.
messages.追踪钟珠尚未绕开时是否急着贴近？短扑和慢弹来自不同时间，先想好两者相遇时自己的位: Did you rush in before shedding the orb? Think where you will be when the slow shot and quick pounce meet.
messages.退潮与黑水之外，学徒仍守着归还的名字；可以回钟庭看看那些名布。: Beyond the ebb and the black water, the apprentice keeps watch over the returned names. Visit the court to see the strips of name-cloth.
messages.退路已经确认；可以再问一句，新约下的照看与轮值该由谁同意。: His way out is secure. Ask whose consent the new covenant requires before assigning care or a watch.
messages.选择分类查看已知记录。: Choose a category to browse your records.
messages.选择左侧归档查看已知记录。浏览不会恢复或覆盖存档。: Select an archive on the left to browse its records. Browsing preserves your current save.
messages.选择已经做出；回到各区看看它留下了什么。: Your choice is made. Return to each region to see what it has left behind.
messages.避开战车后，退路是否被灰钉占住？下一次移动前先看地面，再考虑能否贴近车身。: Did ash spikes block your retreat after you dodged the chariot? Check the ground before drawing close to it again.
messages.避开扇形孢子后，是否又站回菌圈的落点？先选安全地面，再决定要不要追近。: Did you dodge the spores only to step back into a fungal circle? Choose safe ground before pursuing.
messages.避开枪尖后也别踩回尾迹；跳过烛蜡再靠近。: Evade the spear point, then jump the wax rather than stepping back onto the trail.
messages.避开花粉后继续观察下一圈，不在旧落点久留。: After sidestepping the pollen, watch for the next circle. Keep moving off old landing spots.
messages.释放共鸣回应对应设施，也能作用于周围战斗。: Release a pulse to awaken resonant devices or strike nearby enemies.
messages.重冲之后，灰钉会留下暂时路障。: Ash spikes remain as temporary barriers after the charge.
messages.重鸣并没有解开每一根旧缚；若还答应了根笼里的人，可以继续确认他的退路。: The returning bells have not loosened every old bond. If you made a promise to the person in the root cage, you can still make sure he has a way out.
messages.针击、绯线与疗伤: Needle Strikes, Crimson Thread and Healing
messages.针尖朝下，脚下的裂纹先开了口。我不必每次都绕开障碍。: I point my needle down and the crack beneath my feet speaks first. I needn't take the long way round every obstacle.
messages.针脚贴住石面。我能攀住裂口，也该给后来的人留一条路。: My stitches cling to stone. I can hold this cleft. I should leave a way for whoever comes after me.
messages.钟压、低波与孢子交替，半血后加入根阵。: The bell crush, low waves and spores gain root formations at half health.
messages.钟声与军号都会再来；若已经答应他，就把召回线的来处辨清，让回答留给本人。: The bell and the bugle will both sound again. If you gave him your word, trace the recall thread to its source and leave the answer to him.
messages.钟声听见了我。被删去的名字，也许还能一一应回来。: The bell has heard me. Perhaps the names they struck out can still be answered, one by one.
messages.钟声回来，检修灯仍要人补；缺的花粉蜡不会因重鸣而自行送到。: The bells are back, but someone still has to mend the service lamps. Their missing pollen wax will not deliver itself.
messages.钟声重新响起，更要分清引路与召集；答应的军册、穿行与校灯仍可继续。: With the bells ringing again, guiding people and summoning them must be kept distinct. You can still check the muster roll, learn the passage and align the lamps as promised.
messages.钟壳在针前合拢。挡下这一声，还得自己接住下一针。: The bell shell closes before the needle. I can stop that sound. The next needle is still mine to meet.
messages.钟已经重鸣，删去的名字仍要逐页核对；铃声不能替你把原件交还。: The bells ring again. The names struck out still need checking page by page. A bell cannot hand back an original in your stead.
messages.钟庭的细管原本送声，雨渠的支管仍通向住处。沿两种管路走过，我才记住设施也曾先把人: The court's thin pipes once sent sound out. The canal's branch pipes still run to homes. Walking both routes helped me remember that these works once cared for people first.
messages.钟轮冲身，双向低波逼迫起跳: Rushes forward and sends low waves in both directions to force a jump.
messages.钟轮越过后是否立即落地？接着出现的双向低波有没有让刚才选择的落脚处再次变得危险？: Did you land as soon as the wheel passed? Had the low waves made the landing you picked dangerous again?
messages.钟鸣震波需要站在地面。落稳后朝向目标敲击钟器，再观察震波前方的地形与障碍。: Bell Shockwave requires firm ground. Land, face your target and strike the bell. Watch for terrain and obstacles ahead of the wave.
messages.钟鸣震波需要站在地面。落稳后朝向目标敲击钟器，再观察震波前方的地形与障碍。\n\:
Bell Shockwave requires firm ground. Land, face your target and strike the bell. Watch for terrain and obstacles ahead of the wave.

Using the skill in midair does not queue a ground cast. A Bellfounder can spend bell pressure to strengthen the strike. Make sure you have room to recover before committing.
messages.钟龛、构筑与战具补给: Bell Shrines, Builds and Combat Supplies
messages.钟龛可以调整装备、保存与恢复构筑；途中只能切换已经配置的快捷项，恢复方案不会补充: At a shrine you can change equipment and save or restore a build. On the road you can only switch between assigned shortcuts. Restoring a build does not replenish resources.
messages.钥戟与回旋钥阵压迫，后半段冠门封线配合轮波。: The halberd and spinning keys restrict movement. Later the gate's sealing lines combine with wheel waves.
messages.钥戟压迫、回旋钥阵；半血后冠门封线与轮波: Presses with a key halberd and revolving keys. Below half health, crown-gate seals cross wheel waves.
messages.铃杖与低空钟波覆盖不同距离。: The staff and low waves threaten different ranges.
messages.铃杖近击与双向低空钟波: Strikes nearby foes with a bell staff and sends low bell waves in both directions.
messages.铜环借我一段路，石缝留我一处歇脚。借来的力和自己攀住的边沿，各有该松手的时候。: A bronze ring lends me a stretch of road. A crack in the stone lets me rest. Whether I borrow the pull or cling to the edge myself, there comes a time to let go.
messages.铜环回了一声。我把线收短，试着让抓住的东西不再从手里滑走。: The bronze ring answers once. I draw the thread short and try to keep what I've caught from slipping through my fingers again.
messages.铜环回我的短响，和如今听见的钟声并不相同。我愿意把每一种回应都听完，再决定把线交: The ring's short reply sounds different from the bell I hear now. I'll hear each answer through before I choose whose hands to put the thread in.
messages.铜箍与旧切口之间还隔着细弦。远看是一道牢固的圈，近看却能分出一段段需要照料的连接: Fine strings still run between the bronze hoop and the old cut. From afar it looks like a firm ring. Up close it breaks into links that need tending one by one. A sound join can still break, and pulling it tighter need not help the root grow.

Fine strings still run between the bronze hoop and the old cut. From afar it looks like a firm ring. Up close it breaks into links that need tending one by one. A sound join can still break, and pulling it tighter need not help the root grow.

I followed the thin string back to the trough and thought of the slack a repair must leave. Needle and thread can join two ends. It takes another kind of patience to see where they will grow.
messages.铜铃投罐沿弧线抛出，落地后先示警，再爆裂。墙面会挡住它；贴墙使用前先考虑落点会留: The Bronze Bell Jar arcs through the air. It signals danger on landing, then bursts. Walls stop it, so throwing near a wall may leave the jar on your side.

The Bronze Bell Jar arcs through the air. It signals danger on landing, then bursts. Walls stop it, so throwing near a wall may leave the jar on your side.

Keep moving after the throw. Once your jars run out, check the resupply quote at a bell shrine. Resting or switching builds does not replenish them.
messages.锁钥痕能证明主动封闭，不能补出门外来者的名字，也不能单凭一处痕迹解释所有动机。: The marks show a deliberate closure. They do not supply the visitor's missing name or explain every motive by themselves.
messages.镜刃斜射、侧移影刺；半血后延迟镜池与掠袭: Fires diagonal mirror blades and sidesteps into shadow thrusts. Below half health, delayed mirror pools precede sweeping raids.
messages.镜池新娘：留名与召回同时存在: The Mirrorpool Bride: Names Kept, Soldiers Recalled
messages.长扑之后还有迟发的回声落点。: A delayed echo follows the long pounce.
messages.长枪平刺与上挑，攻击距离不同: Alternates level thrusts and rising sweeps with different reaches.
messages.长枪连段与军旗落阵后有明显停顿。: A clear pause follows the spear combo and falling banners.
messages.长枪连段与军旗落阵，攻后停顿明显: Chains spear thrusts and drops a banner formation, then pauses visibly.
messages.门边的朝圣者明确说没有听见守母当时的回答。谁添了后面的线，仍要沿原件继续查。: The pilgrim by the gate was clear about never hearing the Matriarch's answer. The original traces may still show who added the later lines.
messages.闪位后的影刃延迟出手，位置预警会保留。: The blade strikes late after the blink. Its warning stays visible.
messages.闪位后的迟发影刃，位置预警保留到出手: Blinks away and leaves a delayed shadow blade. The position warning remains until the strike.
messages.闪开本体后仍看镜池标记，等延迟掠袭结束再停留。: Watch the pool marks even after dodging her body. Remain mobile until the delayed sweep is over.
messages.阀旁的记号一高一低，视线沿铜管走过去，才发现水位与轮班并不是写在同一个平面上。读: One mark by the valve sits high and another low. Following the bronze pipes with my eyes, I realised the water level and the shift marks aren't on the same plane. To read them together, you have to move.

One mark by the valve sits high and another low. Following the bronze pipes with my eyes, I realised the water level and the shift marks aren't on the same plane. To read them together, you have to move.

I tried the sequence in my head: check the water, then whose turn it is. Loosen one valve, then tighten another. The machinery drowns out voices. These tiny cuts kept the sequence where a hand could find it.

messages.集齐后，第三扇结局门可以打开: Collect all the testimonies to open the third ending gate.
messages.需要接触真实墙面；装饰、背景和空中的边缘不能攀附。: You need a solid wall. Scenery, backgrounds and suspended edges offer no grip.
messages.需要绯线和收势间隔；现场设施仍各有条件。: The pulse costs thread and takes time to recover. Each device has its own requirements.
messages.需要范围内的有效钩环；不能隔着岩壁牵引。: The ring must be within reach. A hook cannot pull you through rock.
messages.需要面向攻击并留足绯线；不能一直维持。: Face the attack with enough thread to spare. The guard lasts only a moment.
messages.面向可见钩环按 {hook}。用 {aim_up} / {aim_down} 调: Face a visible hook ring and press {hook}. Aim with {aim_up} or {aim_down}. Press {jump} as you reel in to let go.

Face a visible hook ring and press {hook}. Aim with {aim_up} or {aim_down}. Press {jump} as you reel in to let go.

The hook can only catch rings within reach and clear of obstacles. Without a suitable ring the button still performs a hook attack.
messages.面向来袭方向按 {bell_guard}，短暂展开钟壳。: Face the incoming attack and press {bell_guard} to briefly open your bell guard.

Face the incoming attack and press {bell_guard} to briefly open your bell guard.

Guarding spends crimson thread and only lasts a moment. Catching a blockable hit in time refunds a little thread. Dodge attacks from behind and unblockable hazards.
messages.首领不会被定身；遇到它们时把绊线钉当作有限的地面战具。离开练习空间时，练习给予的: Stakes cannot immobilise bosses. Treat them as a limited ground tool in those fights. Free uses from the practice room stay there.
messages.首领不受诱导。铃声提供的是换位机会，不能代替开启门闩、清除地形或取得战斗胜利。: Bosses ignore the lure. The bell gives you an opening to move. It cannot unlatch doors, clear terrain or win a fight for you.
messages.首领受到的控制较弱，线阵也不会替你挡住已经飞出的攻击。校录消耗盐记可延长本次控制: Bosses resist the snare, and it cannot stop projectiles already in flight. A Scribe can spend salt marks to extend the effect. Leave yourself a way out when it ends.
messages.香灰弹从空中持续撒落。: Ash projectiles keep falling from above.
messages.香灰弹落下时，是否每一步都有下一处地面可去？向它接近之前，先看退路会不会被新落点: Did each step give you another place to go? Before approaching, check whether a fresh fall of ash will cut off your retreat.
messages.驻足摇铃，孢子扇射与延迟菌圈: Stops to ring its bell, spraying spores in a fan and leaving delayed fungal circles.
messages.骑士曾替亡者应答，也承认自己的害怕。这是一个参与者的证言，不代表每个被点名者已经: The knight answered for the dead and admits being afraid. This is one participant's testimony. It cannot speak for everyone whose name was called.
messages.骑士记得统帅亲手留下名字，也怕军令按号码把人召回。悼念与征召在同一个统帅身上纠缠: The knight remembers the commander preserving names and fears the orders that summoned people by number. Grief and conscription were tangled together in one commander. Neither truth cancels out the other.
messages.高处先标出俯冲位置，之后还有低浪。: A mark from above warns of a dive followed by a low wave.
messages.高悬钟舌先标记俯冲，再放低位钟浪: Hangs high, marks a dive, then sends out a low bell wave.
messages.黑水没有被王冠继续压住；完成补灯约定，才有人能辨认脚下的检修路。: The crown no longer holds the black water down. Keep your promise to mend the lamps so people can find the service path underfoot.
